The Idea

Entertainment on a scale that has never existed.

Not a television. Not a projector. A monumental outdoor screen that turns an estate or a resort into the most unforgettable seat in the house — then vanishes back into the ground when the evening ends.

Impossible to ignore. Effortless to live with.

Wide enough to hold a landscape. Thin enough to disappear against the horizon.

How It Works

Three moments.

01

It rises.

Summon it from your phone or tablet. The screen ascends from a flush seam in the ground and settles into place.

02

It dazzles.

Vivid enough to watch in full daylight, luminous after dark. A picture built for open air, at a size nothing else can match.

03

It disappears.

When the night is over, lower it away. Your view returns, uninterrupted — as if it were never there.

Bright by day.

Most outdoor screens wait for darkness. Milano doesn't.

The Experience

From a quiet film for two to a party under the stars.

A private cinema on a still evening. The big game with fifty guests. A gallery of art above the water at golden hour. One screen, every occasion — at home, or as the amenity that sets a resort apart.
